name: Translation and Proofreading
description: English text is checked for spelling and grammar, German text is translated into English, on this computer only. In the inspector (its own tab) or in a window of its own: the text goes in, the result comes out with every change marked, live while you type; a click on a word keeps the original or offers other words, a double click shows its spelling suggestions, words of a similar meaning and the model's other words at the bottom. A single word gets every suggestion. Dialogue keeps its quotation marks as written. Rules: no em-dashes, American spelling, curly quotes, three periods instead of the ellipsis character, and your own replacements. The models are chosen and downloaded once under File > Options > Proofreading (CoEdIT, Qwen3 1.7B and 4B, OPUS-MT), checked, and then used without any connection; models too large for the computer are not offered. Engine: CTranslate2 with oneDNN and SentencePiece. Brings Qt's TLS plugin for the download.
author: The Quillbinder Translation Add-on project
whatsNew: More models to choose from: Qwen3 1.7B and 4B (proofreading and translation, told to leave your style and dialogue alone) and a larger OPUS-MT translator; a model too large for the computer is not offered or loaded
Live: the result follows about a second after you stop typing; only the sentences you changed are worked on again
A single word gets its spelling suggestions and words of a similar meaning; a double click on any word shows them in a new area at the bottom
Dialogue is kept as written: quotation marks stay where you put them, no stray commas
